<thought>Based on the molecular formula C9H10ClNO, the N‑MR data (3 H singlet ~2.7 ppm for an N‑CH₃, 2 H singlet ~4.6 ppm for a benzylic CH₂ attached to N, and four aromatic protons consistent with a monosubstituted phenyl bearing a chlorine), the structure is a 4‑chlorobenzyl N‑methyl amide: Cl‑Ph‑CH₂‑N(CH₃)‑C(=O)H. The corresponding SMILES is “Clc1ccc(cc1)CN(C)C=O”.</thought>
<final_answer>Clc1ccc(cc1)CN(C)C=O</final_answer>
